svg.title: Four memory types
svg.desc: Working, episodic, semantic and procedural memory side by side. Working memory is the context window, and it lasts until the session ends or the window is compacted. Episodic memory is the record of what happened across sessions, kept in time order. Semantic memory holds what is true, such as a fact about the user. Procedural memory holds the rules the agent acts by, such as its system prompt.
